issues.description: Numeric threshold for Aufgabe 07 is inconsistent between the problem statement and the solution: the problem requires municipalities with more than 75,000 male or 75,000 female inhabitants, but the solution uses 7,500 (missing a zero). This will produce incorrect/unexpected results and confuse students checking their queries against the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Correct the numeric threshold in the solution for Aufgabe 07 to match the problem statement. Change the WHERE clause to use 75000 (e.g. WHERE einwohner_m > 75000 OR einwohner_w > 75000) so the solution reflects the intended 75,000 cutoff.
